_doc: What the weather does to crops and trees (docs/WEATHER.md 'Weather and the harvest'; owner, 27 Nov; our own touch). Families as in data/catalog/crops.json and trees.json. `spoils_ripe`: a ripe crop of these families left out in this weather withers (Balance weather.spoil_grace_seconds after the weather comes), as growers know: rain rots ripe berries and flowers, storms flatten grain and rot cotton, frost kills the tender crops. Growing crops are never harmed. `loves`: a crop or tree that grew through this weather for at least Balance weather.love_share of its time gives Balance weather.loved_bonus more: sun sweetens berries, melons, grapes and cotton and the sun-loving fruit trees; rain feeds rice, beans and the tropical trees; frost sweetens roots and gives temperate fruit trees their winter chill; misty mornings give shade-grown herbs (tea) their flavour. Plain rain still waters every crop (Balance seasons.rain_bonus).
